page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processors clocked at 2.5 GHz, the instance provides 52 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, translating to approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance configuration contains no attached local SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data retention. Furthermore, it operates without discrete GPU accelerators. The compute-dense design allocates resources primarily toward raw CPU capacity rather than memory capacity, resulting in a low RAM-to-vCPU ratio typical of dedicated compute-optimized instance types.

The ecs.c6.13xlarge server is structured for compute-heavy workloads that benefit from high multi-threaded processing power without requiring extensive memory overhead. Appropriate applications include batch processing, distributed code compilation, video encoding, media rendering, web serving clusters, and compute-bound ETL pipelines. Its high vCPU density offers qualitative resource efficiency for parallel execution tasks relying on cloud-attached block storage.
